style.look: Painted storybook illustration of a place in a small medieval fantasy world, soft gouache with visible brush texture, muted natural colours, soft light and long soft shadows, hand-painted, a simple pre-industrial handmade world with no electric light, no poles or wires, no aerials, no modern clothing, no logos, and no writing or symbols unless the scene asks for them, one single full-bleed image with no fold, frame or border, no text, lettering, signature or watermark anywhere, wide landscape composition
style.keepOut: photorealism, 3d render, anime, neon colours, modern objects

parts.act1: Warm late-day light, earthy greens and straw golds, homely and lived-in, in a fantasy setting
parts.act2: Clear daylight and richer colour, deep greens, warm reds and creams, a faint grey haze at the edges, in a fantasy setting
parts.act3: Cooler, wilder light, colours a little drained, as if a sickness were creeping into the land, in a fantasy setting
parts.act4: Cold, dim light, violet and grey shadows, colours drained almost to stone, a hush of dread, in a fantasy setting

act1-abandoned-shed.text: A rickety shed stands precariously at the edge of Willowbrook, its weathered boards creaking in the wind. Rusty tools and broken crates are scattered outside, and a thick layer of dust covers everything. Little light gets past the grimy boards, and the air smells of old earth and lamp oil. the door is bolted shut. there are cat tracks outside.
act1-abandoned-shed.gameWas: A rickety shed leans precariously at the edge of Willowbrook, its weathered boards creaking in the wind. Rusty tools and broken crates are scattered about a long workbench, and a thick layer of dust covers everything. Little light gets past the grimy boards, and the air smells of old earth and lamp oil.

act1-abandoned-shed-inside.text: The inside of a small tool shed with wooden plan walls. In the room there is a broken shovel, a workbench, a number of crates. On top of the workbench stands a very small mysterious box. The shed door is ajar. There are shelves on one of the walls.
act1-abandoned-shed-inside.gameWas: A rickety shed leans precariously at the edge of Willowbrook, its weathered boards creaking in the wind. Rusty tools and broken crates are scattered about a long workbench, and a thick layer of dust covers everything. Little light gets past the grimy boards, and the air smells of old earth and lamp oil.

fishing-rod-appears.text: Add a simple wooden fishing rod on top of the shelf
fishing-rod-appears.gameWas: Add the fishing rod to the picture.

magnet-appears.text: Add a small horseshoe shaped red and white magnet on the shelf
magnet-appears.gameWas: Add the magnet to the picture.

act1-blacksmiths-forge.text: A smoky forge. Coals glow in the hearth. The blacksmith stands next to an anvil with a hammer in his hand. He wears a rough undyed linen shirt, sleeves rolled past the elbow, under a scorched leather apron; forearms like fence posts, old burns on his knuckles. There is a small horseshoe on the wall.
act1-blacksmiths-forge.gameWas: A hot, smoky forge. Coals glow in the hearth and the anvil rings. Hinges, ploughshares and horseshoes hang from the walls, waiting to be mended or fetched, and Borin wipes his brow without putting down the hammer.

act1-chicken-coop.text:
A small wooden coop stands here, its planks patched and weathered. Nervous chickens cluck and flutter, their feathers ruffled as they dart between straw nests. Sunbeams slip through the slats, casting striped shadows on the dirt floor. Inside the coop, there is a rafter and on top of that, something glints.
There is an egg and a feather lying on the ground.
act1-chicken-coop.gameWas: A small wooden coop stands here, its planks patched and weathered. Nervous chickens cluck and flutter, their feathers ruffled as they dart between straw nests. The air is thick with the scent of hay and the occasional squawk. Sunbeams slip through the slats, casting striped shadows on the dirt floor. High on a rafter, out of reach, something glints where no hen could have put it.

key-appears.text: Add a key on the rafter.
key-appears.gameWas: Add the key to the picture.

act1-eliors-cottage.text:
The inside of a modest cottage with a cozy hearth and a book shelf with books.
There are no windows.
The room is dark and the corner by your bed is pitch black.  A sturdy wooden table sits in the center, with a small loaf cooling on it, and a gentle fire crackles in the hearth. Grandmother stands by it, humming, and keeps an eye on the bread. The room is lit only by the hearth fire; the walls are bare plaster and timber with no fittings on them.
act1-eliors-cottage.gameWas: A modest cottage with a straw roof and a cozy hearth. The scent of fresh bread and old books fills the air. The doorway to your room stands open, and the room beyond it is too dark to see into. A sturdy wooden table sits in the center, with a small loaf cooling on it, and a gentle fire crackles in the hearth. Grandmother stands by your doorway, humming, and keeps an eye on the bread.

faded-photograph-appears.text: Add a small framed photograph depicting two adults standing. The photograph  should be painted like warm late-day light, earthy greens and straw golds, homely and lived-in, in a fantasy setting
faded-photograph-appears.gameWas: Add the faded photograph to the picture.

lantern-carried.text: take the lantern off the table; nothing else changes.
lantern-carried.gameWas: Lying on the lit corner: take the lantern off the table, as if Elior had it in her hand; nothing else changes.

lantern-lit.text: In this black area there is a second room where you can see a small table with a lantern and a book.
lantern-lit.gameWas: Light the lantern on the table: a small warm flame in the glass.

patches-appears.text: Add a black cat to the picture.

act1-forest-path.text: A winding path snakes into the heart of the woods, dappled sunlight flickering through the canopy above. A section of the path is blocked by thick, thorny vines. The air is alive with the scent of pine and wildflowers, and the ground is soft with moss and fallen leaves. A bird flit between branches, and the occasional snap of a twig hints at unseen creatures nearby.
act1-forest-path.gameWas: A winding path snakes into the heart of the woods, dappled sunlight flickering through the canopy above. Beside the path, thick, thorny vines block a small alcove. The air is alive with the scent of pine and wildflowers, and the ground is soft with moss and fallen leaves. Birds flit between branches, and the occasional snap of a twig hints at unseen creatures nearby.

snare-appears.text: Add trap in the alcove, with a fox kit caught in it.
snare-appears.gameWas: Add the snare in the alcove, with a fox kit caught in it.

snare-cut.text: Show the trap cut and empty, the fox kit gone.
snare-cut.gameWas: Show the snare cut and empty, the fox kit gone.

act1-general-store.text:
A well stocked shop with the shutters half down. Rope, apples, armors and weapons are lined up neatly in the shelves in the gloom. There are price tags on everything. The shopkeeper stands by the shelves, stacking apples.
There is a box of matches on the bench.
act1-general-store.gameWas: A cluttered shop with the shutters half down. Rope, apples and trinkets crowd the shelves in the gloom. Hemlock stands at the window, watching the lane to the chapel.

matches-gone.text: Remove the box of matches from the picture.
matches-gone.gameWas: Remove the matches from the picture.

patches-appears.text: Add a sleeping black cat to the picture.

shutters-raised.text: Remove  all the green window shutters .
shutters-raised.gameWas: Raise the window shutters all the way.

act1-hidden-glade.text:
A hushed clearing hidden deep within the forest, dim and overgrown. Brambles crowd its edges, and the tall grass stands grey and still beneath branches that shut out the sun. In the center, a mossy boulder stands. An unnatural darkness lingers here, though the sky above the branches is clear.
There is a tiny shiny pebble on the ground.
act1-hidden-glade.gameWas: A hushed clearing hidden deep within the forest, dim and overgrown. Brambles crowd its edges, and the tall grass stands grey and still beneath branches that shut out the sun. In the center, a mossy stone bears a faint inscription, too deep in shadow to read. An unnatural darkness lingers here, though the sky above the branches is clear.

deer-appears.text: Add a majestic deer with huge horns to the picture.

rare-flower-appears.text: Add the rare, glowing flower to the picture.
rare-flower-appears.gameWas: Add the rare flower to the picture.

act1-miras-hut.text:
The inside of a small hut hung with drying herbs: lavender, sage, and roots in bundles from the rafters. Shelves of bottles line the walls, every one labelled. Mira, the mysterious healer, a middle aged woman dressed in a hooded cloak, her face turned away, moves among them without looking, the way you move through your own kitchen.
There is a bookshelf against the farther wall. On one of its shelves stands a small, ancient amulet on a string.
act1-miras-hut.gameWas: A small hut hung with drying herbs: lavender, sage, and roots in bundles from the rafters. Shelves of bottles line the walls, every one labelled. Mira moves among them without looking, the way you move through your own kitchen.

act1-old-mill.text: A creaky windmill towers above, its sails turning slowly in the breeze. The scent of flour hangs in the air. Sunlight illuminates sacks of grain and a heavy millstone. The door to the mill is ajar and nside the mill, you notice a strange mechanism of black iron, whirring to itself, that doesn't belong to the mill's original design.
act1-old-mill.gameWas: A creaky windmill towers above, its sails turning slowly in the breeze. Dusty gears and cobwebs fill the interior, and the scent of flour hangs in the air. Sunlight streams through broken windows, illuminating sacks of grain and a heavy millstone. Amidst the old workings, you notice a strange mechanism of black iron, whirring to itself, that doesn't belong to the mill's original design.

act1-portrait-deer.text: A face portrait of a red-brown deer, its dark eyes calm and unafraid and its ears turned toward you. The deer is standing in the middle of a forest.
act1-portrait-deer.gameWas: A face portrait of a red-brown deer, its dark eyes calm and unafraid and its ears turned toward you.

act1-portrait-dream-voice.text: A face portrait of a cloaked man but the face is hidden and you can only see a siluette. The background is a stormy night with thunder and lightning.
act1-portrait-dream-voice.gameWas: A face portrait of a tall dark figure in rain-soaked shadow, with no face you can make out, only a pale blur where a face should be, like smoke.

act1-portrait-grandmother.text: A face portrait of your grandmother.
act1-portrait-grandmother.gameWas: Your grandmother, flour on her apron and her sleeves pushed up. She has raised you since your parents went away, and she keeps her hands busy when she would rather not answer.

act1-portrait-patches.text: A face portrait of a pitch black cat with wide green eyes.
act1-portrait-patches.gameWas: A face portrait of a small cat with a patchwork coat of ginger, black and white, and wide green eyes.

act1-riverbank.text: A gentle river flows past the village and makes a slow bend here, past the reeds and a broad, flat stone at the water's edge. A couple of insects hum over the water. A weathered old fisherman in a homespun wool smock and a shapeless felt hood sits on an upturned crate at the bend, watching the water, his bad arm held close to his side. His hands are empty: no rod, no line, no net. Beyond the reeds, only thatched cottages and trees.
act1-riverbank.gameWas: A gentle river flows past the village and makes a slow bend here, past the reeds and a broad, flat stone at the water's edge. Insects hum over the water. A weathered fisherman sits on an upturned crate at the bend, watching the water.

act1-road-to-greendale.text:
The main road out of Willowbrook runs east under old oaks, their branches meeting overhead. The way is well trodden, lined with wildflowers and fallen leaves. A merchant's cart stands beside the road. Next to the card is the merchant and his mare.
Behind one of the oaks on the left, you can see the tip of a rusty saw blade.
act1-road-to-greendale.gameWas: The main road out of Willowbrook runs east under old oaks, their branches meeting overhead. The way is well trodden, lined with wildflowers and fallen leaves. A merchant's cart stands at the roadside, and his thin grey mare grazes beside it on three good shoes.

act1-the-dream.text: It is dark, and it is raining hard. In the clouds, you can see the outlines of a cloaked man. You hear it beating on shutters, though you cannot see any. Thunder breaks so close that the dark shakes with it. Shadows drift past like smoke. A man’s hand reaches out of the dark, lifts a child and holds it against his shoulder, and then both of them are gone. Somewhere a slow tune climbs three notes and settles home again. A tall figure stands among the shadows. It has no face you can find. It is too far away to reach, and too close to be only a dream. It is whispering, at the very edge of hearing, and what it whispers is your name.
act1-the-dream.gameWas: It is dark, and it is raining hard. You hear it beating on shutters, though you cannot see any. Thunder breaks so close that the dark shakes with it. Shadows drift past like smoke. A man’s hand reaches out of the dark, lifts a child and holds it against his shoulder, and then both of them are gone. Somewhere a slow tune climbs three notes and settles home again. A tall figure stands among the shadows. It has no face you can find. It is too far away to reach, and too close to be only a dream. It is whispering, at the very edge of hearing, and what it whispers is your name.

act1-vegetable-field.text: Rows of withered, rotten plants, nearly lying down, beneath a brooding gray sky. The earth is cracked and dry. A  single small, withered, black carrot is laying on he ground in the middle of the image.  A hoe is leaned against one of the plantas on the left hand side of the image. a rusty knife is on the ground on the right hand side of the image.
act1-vegetable-field.gameWas: Rows of withered crops stretch beneath the last grey of the night's storm. The earth is cracked and dry, with only a few stubborn carrots and a rusty trowel hinting at better days. A faint breeze rustles the brittle leaves, carrying the scent of soil and distant rain. On market day these rows were green.

act1-village-chapel.text:
A small stone room. It is very dark, A small stained glass window cast colors across the worn pews. A kindly priest tends an altar. There is a prayer book on the altar. On the far wall, the church bell rope hangs straight and still. Over the door, a small carving cut into the stone: a tree under two moons, its edges worn soft with age but the shape still clear. No other carving, letters, writing or symbols anywhere on the walls or the door. A dark corner by the altar swallows the light completely.
There is a box of short, white rods on the floor.
act1-village-chapel.gameWas: A small stone chapel at the end of the village lane. Its stained glass windows cast colours across the worn pews, and the air is cool and smells of candle wax. A kindly priest tends the altar. By the door the bell rope hangs straight and still. Above the door a faint carving, worn almost smooth, shows a tree under two moons. A dark corner by the altar swallows the light.

candle-lit.text: Light a candle on the altar: a small steady flame, and the room becomes a bit lighter.
candle-lit.gameWas: Light the candle on the altar: a small steady flame, and the dark corner beside it lit.

locket-appears.text: add a small gold locket on the wall close to the floor behind the altar
locket-appears.gameWas: Add the locket to the picture.

act1-village-square.text: The heart of Willowbrook, a medieval village: cobblestones around an old stone fountain, and a weathered notice board covered in faded announcements. The text is unreadable. Half the market stalls stand empty. The people at the others keep their voices down, and stop talking when you pass. All the people are dressed in medieval clothes. No one is wearing a hat.
act1-village-square.gameWas: The heart of Willowbrook: cobblestones around an old stone fountain, and a weathered notice board covered in faded announcements. Half the market stalls stand empty. The people at the others keep their voices down, and stop talking when you pass.

act1-village-well.text: An old stone well stands between the field and the forge, its stones worn smooth by countless hands. The water below lies foul, dark and still and have a greenish light over it. Moss creeps up the sides.
act1-village-well.gameWas: An old stone well stands between the field and the forge, its stones worn smooth by countless hands. The water below lies dark and still, and a faint sour smell hangs in the cool, damp air. Moss creeps up the sides.

well-purified.text: Change the greenish color of the water to dark blue
well-purified.gameWas: Make the water in the well clear and bright instead of dark and still.

act2-ancient-grove.text: A ring of trees so old their trunks are wider than a cottage. Text is carved in their bark, older than any letters you know. In the middle stands one tree taller than the rest, with bark the colour of tarnished silver. There are no houses here.
act2-ancient-grove.gameWas: A ring of trees so old their trunks are wider than a cottage. Signs are carved in their bark, older than any letters you know. In the middle stands one tree taller than the rest, with bark the colour of tarnished silver.

ancient-tree-spirit-appears.text: A stern, ancient face grows out of the silver-white bark of the central tree, made of the wood itself: bark ridges for brow and cheeks, a deep red-brown crack running down through the forehead and chin, pale green eyes, eyebrows and a drooping moustache of green moss. Its edges melt into the trunk; no hair, no skin, no separate head.
ancient-tree-spirit-appears.gameWas: Add Ancient Tree Spirit to the picture.

exit-south-open.text: The brambles and roots in this gap have drawn back and parted like a curtain, leaving a clear opening with a narrow earthen footpath leading through it into the green forest beyond. The torn bramble ends curl aside on both sides of the opening.
exit-south-open.gameWas: Show the way south open and passable.

silver-leaves-appears.text: A small scatter of fallen leaves with a bright silver sheen lies on the grass at the foot of the silver-barked tree, between its roots. Only the leaves are added; the grass, roots and brambles around them stay exactly as they are.
silver-leaves-appears.gameWas: Add the silver leaves to the picture.

exit-west-open.text: Remove the iron gate leaves and their bars from between the two gateposts, leaving an empty gateway through which the paved path and the lawn behind are seen clearly. Nothing else changes.
exit-west-open.gameWas: Show the way west open and passable.

squires-diary-appears.text: A small, worn brown leather diary lies on the grass in the shadow under the left stone bench, partly hidden by the bench seat. Only the diary is added; the bench, grass and everything else stay exactly as they are.
squires-diary-appears.gameWas: Add the squire's diary to the picture.

act2-forest-entrance.text: You standing in front dof a thick forest with Massive trees looming over you. Dappled sunlight filters through the dense canopy. The air is alive with birds and rustling leaves, but beneath it lies an expectant silence, as if the forest itself is watching.
act2-forest-entrance.gameWas: Massive trees create a natural cathedral as you enter the Enchanted Forest. Dappled sunlight filters through the dense canopy, and the path ahead disappears into green shadows. The air is alive with birds and rustling leaves, but beneath it lies an expectant silence, as if the forest itself is watching.

caravan-appears.text: A small group of battered, weary merchants in travel-stained clothes sit and stand on the grass among a few wooden crates, sacks and bundles of goods they carried up; a coil of rope is tied around a tree trunk and trails away behind it. Life-size for where they are, the same painted style. The trees and ferns stay exactly as they are.
caravan-appears.gameWas: Add the caravan to the picture.

enchanted-acorn-taken.text: Remove the acorn from the edge of the path; where it lay there is only the same path, grass and earth. Nothing else changes.
enchanted-acorn-taken.gameWas: Remove the enchanted acorn from the picture.

exit-east-open.text: A soft blue lantern light shines into the dark tangled undergrowth at the far left, picking out a narrow path that winds through it into the trees. The big trunk and the ferns in front stay as they are.
exit-east-open.gameWas: Show the way east open and passable.

forest-sprites-aside.text: Remove the cloud of glowing motes from above the path so the way ahead is clear and passable; a few small glowing motes now hover off to the sides among the tree trunks. The trees, path and light stay exactly as they are.
forest-sprites-aside.gameWas: Move the forest sprites away from the southern path, among the trees, and show the way south open and passable.

ravine-appears.text: Far in the background, low between the distant trees, a small glimpse of a rocky drop: the forest floor breaks off at a mossy edge and a narrow grey stone gorge falls away into shadow. It is distant, small and soft in the misty light, blending into the forest. The two near trunks stay exactly as they are.
ravine-appears.gameWas: Add the ravine to the picture.

exit-east-open.text: Remove the bushes and undergrowth between the trees at the right, so a narrow earthen footpath is revealed, running from the grass past the big tree into the forest beyond. The tree trunks, standing stones and everything else stay exactly as they are.
exit-east-open.gameWas: Show the way east open and passable.

act2-greendale-gates.text: In the city walls stands a magnificent stone archway with sturdy wooden doors that marks the entrance to the largest settlement you have encountered. Guards in polished mail stand watch, banners fluttering in the mountain breeze. Beyond, cobblestone streets wind between stone houses and bustling shops. The air carries the sounds of commerce—a stark contrast to Willowbrook's quiet charm.
act2-greendale-gates.gameWas: A magnificent stone archway marks the entrance to Greendale, the largest settlement you have encountered. Guards in polished mail stand watch, banners fluttering in the mountain breeze. Beyond, cobblestone streets wind between stone houses and bustling shops. The air carries the sounds of commerce—a stark contrast to Willowbrook's quiet charm.

city-map-appears.text: A folded parchment map of the city, drawn in brown and grey ink, is pinned to the small hanging wooden sign by the door, partly unfolded so its streets show. Nothing else changes.
city-map-appears.gameWas: Add the city map to the picture.

gate-captain-gone.text: Remove the gate captain standing in the middle of the road; where he stood, the cobbled street runs on clear through the open archway into the town. The gates, guards and everything else stay exactly the same.
gate-captain-gone.gameWas: Remove Gate Captain from the picture and show the way north open and passable.

act2-healers-house.text: Inside of a small stone house that smells of crushed herbs. A few bundles of dried plants still hang from the rafters, but the shelves below them are nearly bare: rows of empty bottles, rinsed and waiting. A fire burns in the hearth, and a door at the back stands half shut.
act2-healers-house.gameWas: A small stone house that smells of crushed herbs. A few bundles of dried plants still hang from the rafters, but the shelves below them are nearly bare: rows of empty bottles, rinsed and waiting. A fire burns in the hearth, and a door at the back stands half shut.

act2-heart-of-the-forest.text: The deepest part of the forest. The light here is green and gold and does not seem to come from the sky. A tree vaster than any other holds up the branches overhead, and before it stands an altar with a carved star on it The forest is so thick so the only way out is back the way you came..
act2-heart-of-the-forest.gameWas: The deepest part of the forest. The light here is green and gold and does not seem to come from the sky. A tree vaster than any other holds up the branches overhead, and before it stands an altar of starstone. The only way out is back north, to the grove.

nyx-appears.text: A slender barefoot woman stands on the grass to the right of the altar, facing the viewer: shoulder-length wavy brown hair with green leaves caught in it, a simple long pale linen dress, calm green eyes. The moss at her feet is a brighter green. Life-size beside the altar, in the same painted style. The altar, roots and tree stay exactly the same.

act2-hidden-library.text: Discovered beneath Greendale through a secret passage, this ancient library holds countless volumes of magical lore. Glowing crystals mounted as torches provide soft illumination and the air hums with residual energy. Protective enchantments shimmer around the most valuable texts. Somewhere on these shelves may be an answer about the mark you carry.
act2-hidden-library.gameWas: Discovered beneath Greendale through a secret passage, this ancient library holds countless volumes of magical lore. Glowing crystals provide soft illumination and the air hums with residual energy. Protective enchantments shimmer around the most valuable texts. Somewhere on these shelves may be an answer about the mark you carry.

crystal-focus-appears.text: On the stone floor lies a small folded blue cloth, no bigger than a hand and much smaller than the book on the cabinet, with a tiny clear crystal on it that catches the light in a single bright glint. Small in the scene; the floor around stays the same.
crystal-focus-appears.gameWas: Add the crystal focus to the picture.

act2-inn-rooms.text: A comfortable guest room. in a medieval inn. The room has a cozy bed, a writing desk, and a window overlooking the Market District. The room is clean and well-maintained, offering a peaceful retreat for travelers. Faint conversation drifts up from the common room below.
act2-inn-rooms.gameWas: Comfortable guest rooms on the upper floor of The Silver Stag Inn. Each room has a cozy bed, a writing desk, and a window overlooking the Market District. The rooms are clean and well-maintained, offering a peaceful retreat for travelers. Faint conversation drifts up from the common room below.

coins-taken.text: Remove the pile of gold coins from the bedside table top; only the bare wooden table top and the candlestick remain. Nothing else changes.
coins-taken.gameWas: Remove the coins from the picture.

travelers-journal-appears.text: One floorboard beside the foot of the bed has been lifted and leans aside, showing a dusty hollow beneath, and in it lies a plain worn brown leather journal. The rest of the floor stays the same.
travelers-journal-appears.gameWas: Add the traveler's journal to the picture.

act2-main-square.text: The heart of Greendale: a great fountain with statues of old heroes fighting beasts, stalls under bright awnings, red roofs all round. The square is crowded, but the talk is low, and it stops when a guard walks past. Castle towers rise to the north.
act2-main-square.gameWas: The heart of Greendale: a great fountain of old heroes fighting beasts, stalls under bright awnings, red roofs all round. The square is crowded, but the talk is low, and it stops when a guard walks past. Castle towers rise to the north.

merchants-flyer-taken.text: Remove the bright yellow flyer from the lower corner of the notice board; only bare board wood and a small empty pin remain there. The other notices stay exactly the same.
merchants-flyer-taken.gameWas: Remove the merchant's flyer from the picture.

enhanced-lantern-appears.text: A brass lantern with a bright, steady, faintly bluish magical glow hangs from a hook on the stall beam above the counter. Nothing else changes.
enhanced-lantern-appears.gameWas: Add the enhanced lantern to the picture.

forest-survival-kit-appears.text: A rolled-up canvas bedroll tied with leather straps, with a small pouch and a tin cup bound to it, lies on the right end of the wooden counter top. Nothing else changes.
forest-survival-kit-appears.gameWas: Add the forest survival kit to the picture.

quality-rope-appears.text: A small neat coil of thick hemp rope sits on the left end of the wooden counter top, next to the man's hands. Only the rope is added; nothing else changes.
quality-rope-appears.gameWas: Add the quality rope to the picture.

act2-merchants-warehouse.text: The inside of a large stone building packed with goods from distant lands. Crates and barrels form narrow corridors between tall shelving. Exotic spice and lacquer aromas mingle in the cool still air. This is where the most valuable inventory rests under quiet watch.
act2-merchants-warehouse.gameWas: A large stone building packed with goods from distant lands. Crates and barrels form narrow corridors between tall shelving. Exotic spice and lacquer aromas mingle in the cool still air. This is where the most valuable inventory rests under quiet watch.

entry-pass-appears.text: Under a few brushed-aside dry leaves in front of the stone fire ring lies a folded parchment document with a red wax seal, partly showing. Nothing else changes.
entry-pass-appears.gameWas: Add the entry pass to the picture.

exit-east-open.text: Remove the bushes between the trees at the right edge, revealing a narrow earthen footpath that branches off the slope and runs away to the right between the pines toward a distant forest. The big pine and everything else stay as they are.
exit-east-open.gameWas: Show the way east open and passable.

mountain-flower-taken.text: Remove the clump of purple wildflowers at the foot of the boulder; only the same grass and trail edge remain. The walking stick and boulder stay as they are.
mountain-flower-taken.gameWas: Remove the mountain flower from the picture.

walking-stick-taken.text: Remove the wooden walking stick leaning against the boulder; only the boulder's face remains there. Nothing else changes.
walking-stick-taken.gameWas: Remove the walking stick from the picture.

act2-portrait-spectral-librarian.text: A face portrait of a ghostly scholar shimmering with soft blue light, translucent and gaunt, with a stern, watchful look. The background is a library.
act2-portrait-spectral-librarian.gameWas: A face portrait of a ghostly scholar shimmering with soft blue light, translucent and gaunt, with a stern, watchful look.

act2-portrait-squires.text: A face portrait of a young squire, flushed and freckled, with a sidelong, whispering look. His face facing forward.
act2-portrait-squires.gameWas: A face portrait of a young squire, flushed and freckled, with a leather practice cap and a sidelong, whispering look.

act2-portrait-water-nymphs.text:
A face portrait of a water nymph, her face and hair made of clear flowing stream water, with pale shifting eyes.
In the background there is a dense forest.
act2-portrait-water-nymphs.gameWas: A face portrait of a water nymph, her face and hair made of clear flowing stream water, with pale shifting eyes.

act2-residential-quarter.text: Quiet lanes of two-storey houses in the midst of a medieval city, each with a small garden and a workshop. Craftsmen work at benches in the open doorways, and neighbours sit on their steps. Half the garden plots have gone grey.
act2-residential-quarter.gameWas: Quiet lanes of two-storey houses, each with a small garden and a workshop. Craftsmen work at benches in the open doorways, and neighbours sit on their steps. Half the garden plots have gone grey.

exit-secret-passage-open.text: Remove the bricks filling the arched cellar doorway, so the arch stands open and dark, with worn stone steps leading down into the shadow; a few loose bricks lie on the ground beside it. The wall around it stays the same.
exit-secret-passage-open.gameWas: Show the way secret_passage open and passable.

act2-silver-stag-inn.text: The inside of a medieval/fantasy inn glows with warm yellow light. Conversations from travelers and locals merge into a comforting din while tales are traded over bread and ale. All people are wearing medieval clothes. Stag mounts and adventuring trophies line the walls. The place feels welcoming; information flows here as freely as the drink.
act2-silver-stag-inn.gameWas: A three-story inn glows with warm yellow light. Conversations from travelers and locals merge into a comforting din while tales are traded over bread and ale. Stag mounts and adventuring trophies line the walls. The place feels welcoming; information flows here as freely as the drink.

exit-east-open.text: Remove the closed wooden door from its arched doorway, leaving the doorway open: through it a narrow wooden staircase climbs upward in warm lamplight. The frame, the wall, the deer heads and the drinkers stay exactly as they are.
exit-east-open.gameWas: Show the way east open and passable.

room-key-gone.text: Remove the brass key from the hook on the wooden post; only the empty iron hook remains. Nothing else changes.
room-key-gone.gameWas: Remove the room key from the picture.

act2-whispering-glade.text: In the midst of the forest, a meadow opens round a small stream that runs over smooth stones and ends up in a small pond. Wildflowers grow thick to the water's edge. Under the sound of the water there are other sounds, almost voices, and they stop when you listen for them.
act2-whispering-glade.gameWas: A meadow opens round a small stream that runs over smooth stones. Wildflowers grow thick to the water's edge. Under the sound of the water there are other sounds, almost voices, and they stop when you listen for them.

crystal-clear-water-appears.text: A small corked glass flask of very clear water, no bigger than a hand, painted in the same soft gouache storybook style as the scene with soft edges, sits on the flat stone at the stream's edge. Nothing else changes.
crystal-clear-water-appears.gameWas: Add the crystal-clear water to the picture.

moonflowers-appears.text: A small bunch of pure white flowers, their petals open and glowing faintly with a soft silvery light of their own, lies on the bank at the water's edge. Nothing else changes.
moonflowers-appears.gameWas: Add the moonflowers to the picture.

water-nymphs-appears.text: Three slender water nymphs sit waist-deep in the stream a little way off, small at this distance, their bodies made of the stream's own clear water: translucent, glassy and pale blue, with the rippling water and stones showing through them and their long hair flowing like running water. Ethereal and half-seen, not solid women. The stones and banks stay as they are.
water-nymphs-appears.gameWas: Add Water Nymphs to the picture.

mira-appears.text: Add a cloaked woman to the picture.

prism-lantern-appears.text: Add a small brass lantern with clear prism-cut glass panes, catching the light in tiny rainbows, sitting on top of the rusty locker, no taller than half the locker. The locker and the timbers stay.
prism-lantern-appears.gameWas: Add the prism lantern to the picture.

weathered-coin-taken.text: Remove the green coin from the top of the wooden post, leaving the bare weathered wood. The post and the knight stay.
weathered-coin-taken.gameWas: Remove the weathered coin from the picture.

healing-herbs-gone.text: Remove the bundles of silvery herb stems from the counter, leaving the bare wooden counter. The bottles on the shelves stay.
healing-herbs-gone.gameWas: Remove the healing herbs from the picture.

lifelight-elixir-appears.text: Add a small glass vial of pale golden liquid, glowing softly with the colour of first light, standing on the wooden counter beside the crystal prism, no taller than half the prism. The crystal prism and the bottles stay.
lifelight-elixir-appears.gameWas: Add the lifelight elixir to the picture.

mira-gone.text: Remove the hooded woman in the green cloak, showing the wooden floor, the cupboards and the window behind where she stood. The knight, the herb bundles on the counter and the shelves stay.

warding-pillars-purified.text: Make the three stone pillars clean and pale, washed free of moss and brine, their carved marks glowing with a clear steady silver-blue light. The shape and place of each pillar, the water, the moon and the sky stay.
warding-pillars-purified.gameWas: Show the warding pillars cleansed, their glow clear and steady.

moon-rune-shards-appears.text: Add a small heap of bright silver-white stone shards glowing softly with pale moonlight, clearly visible on the sand at the foot of the stele, the heap about as wide as the knight's shoulders. The stele and the sand stay.
moon-rune-shards-appears.gameWas: Add the moon rune shards to the picture.

polished-shell-taken.text: Remove the pearly sea shell, showing smooth sand and a few pebbles where it lay. The stele and the sand around it stay.
polished-shell-taken.gameWas: Remove the polished shell from the picture.

mira-appears.text: Add one woman in a long dark green hooded cloak standing on the middle causeway, facing the mural, her head no higher than the knight's at the left. Only the woman is added. The paving stones, the water and the knight stay.

rusted-locker-key-appears.text: Add a small corroded iron key, orange with rust, lying on the stone ledge in the dark shadow at the foot of the arch below the mural, about half the size of one paving stone. The stones and the mural stay.
rusted-locker-key-appears.gameWas: Add the rusted locker key to the picture.

sea-sealed-letter-appears.text: Add a small cream parchment letter with a green wax seal lying on the stone ledge below the mural, no bigger than a single paving stone of the ledge. The stone ledge and the mural stay.
sea-sealed-letter-appears.gameWas: Add the sea-sealed letter to the picture.

sorceress-of-lies-unmasked.text: the woman in the picture should be masked
sorceress-of-lies-unmasked.gameWas: Show the sorceress unmasked, her false face gone.

title-screen.text: A quiet village under a lantern-lit night, drawn with open sky across the top third and a calm, uncluttered middle for the buttons. Thatched and slate roofs with stone chimneys and a curl of smoke; nothing on the roofs but chimneys. In the sky, there is a full moon which reflects clearly in the water of a pond in the village. In the clouds, you can see the outlines of a cloaked man.
title-screen.gameWas: The world of Twinmoor at the start of the story: a quiet village under a lantern-lit dusk, drawn with open sky across the top third for the game's name and a calm, uncluttered middle for the buttons.
